issues.description: The member 'width' of class Bitmap24 has different declared types between the template and the solution. In the template header 'Bitmap24.hpp' width is declared as 'short', while in the solution header it is 'int'. The Bitmap24 implementation (constructor) accepts int parameters and initializes 'width' from an int, so the mismatch between template and solution can cause confusion about the intended field size and may lead students to wonder which type is correct or to introduce subtle bugs when porting/using code across provided artifacts.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the 'width' member type consistent across template and solution. Prefer using 'int' for width in the template header (change 'short width;' to 'int width;') to match the constructor and the solution. Alternatively, document explicitly in the problem/template that 'width' is intentionally a short if that was intended.
